#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Analyze τ sweep results for provenance weight training experiments."""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

DEFAULT_UNIFORM_PPL = 17.693
DEFAULT_GRID_BEST_PPL = 17.646

DUMMY_DATA = {
    "0.5": {"eval_ppl": 17.72, "train_loss": 2.91},
    "0.6": {"eval_ppl": 17.69, "train_loss": 2.88},
    "0.7": {"eval_ppl": 17.66, "train_loss": 2.86},
    "0.8": {"eval_ppl": 17.651, "train_loss": 2.85},
    "0.9": {"eval_ppl": 17.67, "train_loss": 2.87},
    "0.95": {"eval_ppl": 17.71, "train_loss": 2.90},
}


def setup_style():
    plt.rcParams.update({
        "font.family": "serif",
        "font.serif": ["Times New Roman", "Times", "DejaVu Serif"],
        "font.size": 9,
        "axes.labelsize": 10,
        "axes.titlesize": 10,
        "xtick.labelsize": 8,
        "ytick.labelsize": 8,
        "legend.fontsize": 8,
        "figure.figsize": (3.5, 2.6),
        "figure.dpi": 150,
        "savefig.dpi": 300,
        "savefig.bbox": "tight",
        "savefig.pad_inches": 0.03,
        "axes.spines.top": False,
        "axes.spines.right": False,
        "axes.grid": False,
        "lines.linewidth": 1.5,
        "lines.markersize": 5,
    })


def load_results(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        raw = json.load(f)
    results = {}
    for tau_str, metrics in raw.items():
        tau = float(tau_str)
        ppl = metrics.get("eval_ppl")
        if ppl is not None:
            results[tau] = {"eval_ppl": ppl, "train_loss": metrics.get("train_loss")}
    return results


def print_table(results, uniform_ppl, grid_best_ppl):
    taus = sorted(results.keys())
    print("\n| τ | eval_ppl | Δ vs uniform | Δ vs grid-best | % of grid-best impr. |")
    print("|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|")
    grid_impr = uniform_ppl - grid_best_ppl
    for tau in taus:
        ppl = results[tau]["eval_ppl"]
        delta_uni = uniform_ppl - ppl
        delta_grid = grid_best_ppl - ppl
        pct = (delta_uni / grid_impr * 100) if grid_impr != 0 else float("nan")
        default_mark = " *" if abs(tau - 0.8) < 1e-9 else ""
        print(f"| {tau:.2f}{default_mark} | {ppl:.3f} | {delta_uni:+.3f} | {delta_grid:+.3f} | {pct:.1f}% |")
    print()


def plot_ppl_curve(results, out_prefix, uniform_ppl, grid_best_ppl):
    taus = sorted(results.keys())
    ppls = [results[t]["eval_ppl"] for t in taus]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.plot(taus, ppls, "o-", color="#2563EB", zorder=3)

    ax.axhline(uniform_ppl, ls="--", color="#6B7280", lw=1,
               label=f"uniform baseline ({uniform_ppl:.3f})")
    ax.axhline(grid_best_ppl, ls="--", color="#D97706", lw=1,
               label=f"grid-best ({grid_best_ppl:.3f})")

    if 0.8 in results:
        ax.axvline(0.8, ls=":", color="#9CA3AF", lw=0.8)
        ax.annotate("default\n(τ=0.8)", xy=(0.8, results[0.8]["eval_ppl"]),
                     xytext=(0.82, results[0.8]["eval_ppl"] + 0.015),
                     fontsize=7, color="#6B7280", ha="left")

    ax.set_xlabel("τ (temperature)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Eval perplexity")
    ax.set_xticks(taus)
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{t:.2f}" for t in taus])
    ax.legend(loc="upper right", frameon=False)

    y_vals = ppls + [uniform_ppl, grid_best_ppl]
    y_min, y_max = min(y_vals), max(y_vals)
    margin = (y_max - y_min) * 0.25
    ax.set_ylim(y_min - margin, y_max + margin)

    fig.savefig(f"{out_prefix}.pdf")
    fig.savefig(f"{out_prefix}.png")
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f"Saved {out_prefix}.pdf and {out_prefix}.png")


def plot_improvement_curve(results, out_prefix, uniform_ppl, grid_best_ppl):
    taus = sorted(results.keys())
    improvements = [uniform_ppl - results[t]["eval_ppl"] for t in taus]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.plot(taus, improvements, "s-", color="#2563EB", zorder=3)
    ax.axhline(0, ls="-", color="#D1D5DB", lw=0.8)

    grid_impr = uniform_ppl - grid_best_ppl
    ax.axhline(grid_impr, ls="--", color="#D97706", lw=1,
               label=f"grid-best improvement ({grid_impr:.3f})")

    if 0.8 in results:
        ax.axvline(0.8, ls=":", color="#9CA3AF", lw=0.8)

    ax.set_xlabel("τ (temperature)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Δ PPL (uniform − τ-weighted)")
    ax.set_xticks(taus)
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{t:.2f}" for t in taus])
    ax.legend(loc="upper right", frameon=False)

    y_vals = improvements + [0, grid_impr]
    y_min, y_max = min(y_vals), max(y_vals)
    margin = (y_max - y_min) * 0.25
    ax.set_ylim(y_min - margin, y_max + margin)

    fig.savefig(f"{out_prefix}.pdf")
    fig.savefig(f"{out_prefix}.png")
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f"Saved {out_prefix}.pdf and {out_prefix}.png")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Analyze τ sweep results: plot PPL curves and print summary table.")
    parser.add_argument("--input", "-i", type=str, default=None,
                        help="JSON file with τ sweep results. Keys are τ values, "
                             "values have 'eval_ppl' and optional 'train_loss'.")
    parser.add_argument("--outdir", "-o", type=str, default=".",
                        help="Output directory for figures (default: current dir)")
    parser.add_argument("--dummy", action="store_true",
                        help="Use dummy data for testing")
    parser.add_argument("--uniform-ppl", type=float, default=DEFAULT_UNIFORM_PPL,
                        help=f"Uniform baseline PPL (default: {DEFAULT_UNIFORM_PPL})")
    parser.add_argument("--grid-best-ppl", type=float, default=DEFAULT_GRID_BEST_PPL,
                        help=f"Grid-best PPL (default: {DEFAULT_GRID_BEST_PPL})")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    uniform_ppl = args.uniform_ppl
    grid_best_ppl = args.grid_best_ppl

    if args.dummy:
        results = {float(k): v for k, v in DUMMY_DATA.items()}
    elif args.input:
        results = load_results(args.input)
    else:
        parser.print_help()
        sys.exit(1)

    if not results:
        print("ERROR: no valid data points (all eval_ppl are null?)", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    setup_style()
    outdir = Path(args.outdir)
    outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    suffix = "_dummy" if args.dummy else ""
    plot_ppl_curve(results, str(outdir / f"tau_sweep_curve{suffix}"),
                   uniform_ppl, grid_best_ppl)
    plot_improvement_curve(results, str(outdir / f"tau_sweep_improvement{suffix}"),
                           uniform_ppl, grid_best_ppl)
    print_table(results, uniform_ppl, grid_best_ppl)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Watch all experiment checkpoints and auto-run eval_perplexity.py on completion."""
import glob
import logging
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

BASE_DIR = "/root/provenance_weight_training"
MODELS_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "output/models")
EVAL_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "output/eval_results")
EVAL_SCRIPT = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "eval_perplexity.py")
DATA_PATH = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "data/human/eval_holdout.jsonl")
LOG_PATH = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "logs/auto_eval_watcher.log")
SCAN_INTERVAL = 60
EVAL_GPU = "3"

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s",
    handlers=[
        logging.FileHandler(LOG_PATH),
        logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout),
    ],
)
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def extract_exp_id(dirname):
    return os.path.basename(dirname)


def find_ready_checkpoints():
    ready = []
    for d in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(MODELS_DIR, "*"))):
        if not os.path.isdir(d):
            continue
        exp_id = extract_exp_id(d)
        final_dir = os.path.join(d, "final")
        if os.path.isdir(final_dir) and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(final_dir, "model.safetensors")):
            result_name = f"{exp_id}_eval.json"
            result_path = os.path.join(EVAL_DIR, result_name)
            if not os.path.exists(result_path):
                ready.append((exp_id, final_dir, result_path))
    return ready


def run_eval(exp_id, checkpoint_path, output_path):
    cmd = [
        sys.executable, EVAL_SCRIPT,
        "--checkpoints", checkpoint_path,
        "--data_path", DATA_PATH,
        "--output_path", output_path,
    ]
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = EVAL_GPU
    log.info(f"Starting eval: {exp_id} -> {output_path}")
    log.info(f"  cmd: {' '.join(cmd)}")
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=1800)
        if proc.returncode == 0:
            log.info(f"Eval succeeded: {exp_id}")
            if proc.stdout:
                for line in proc.stdout.strip().split("\n")[-5:]:
                    log.info(f"  {line}")
            return True
        else:
            log.error(f"Eval failed (rc={proc.returncode}): {exp_id}")
            if proc.stderr:
                for line in proc.stderr.strip().split("\n")[-10:]:
                    log.error(f"  {line}")
            if "CUDA out of memory" in (proc.stderr or ""):
                log.info(f"GPU OOM, retrying on CPU: {exp_id}")
                env["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = ""
                proc2 = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=3600)
                if proc2.returncode == 0:
                    log.info(f"CPU eval succeeded: {exp_id}")
                    return True
                log.error(f"CPU eval also failed: {exp_id}")
            return False
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        log.error(f"Eval timed out: {exp_id}")
        return False
    except Exception as e:
        log.error(f"Eval exception: {exp_id}: {e}")
        return False


def main():
    os.makedirs(EVAL_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(LOG_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    log.info("=" * 60)
    log.info("Auto eval watcher started")
    log.info(f"  Models dir: {MODELS_DIR}")
    log.info(f"  Eval dir:   {EVAL_DIR}")
    log.info(f"  Eval GPU:   {EVAL_GPU}")
    log.info(f"  Interval:   {SCAN_INTERVAL}s")
    log.info("=" * 60)

    evaluated = set()
    while True:
        try:
            ready = find_ready_checkpoints()
            if ready:
                log.info(f"Found {len(ready)} checkpoint(s) to eval")
            for exp_id, ckpt_path, result_path in ready:

"""Watch all experiment checkpoints and auto-run eval_perplexity.py on completion.

GPU selection: env EVAL_GPU overrides; otherwise picks GPU with lowest memory usage via nvidia-smi.
"""
import glob
import logging
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

BASE_DIR = "/root/provenance_weight_training"
MODELS_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "output/models")
EVAL_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "output/eval_results")
EVAL_SCRIPT = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "eval_perplexity.py")
DATA_PATH = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "data/human/eval_holdout.jsonl")
LOG_PATH = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "logs/auto_eval_watcher.log")
SCAN_INTERVAL = 60
MIN_FREE_MB = 15000

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s",
    handlers=[
        logging.FileHandler(LOG_PATH),
        logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout),
    ],
)
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def get_least_loaded_gpu():
    env_gpu = os.environ.get("EVAL_GPU")
    if env_gpu is not None:
        log.info(f"Using EVAL_GPU from env: {env_gpu}")
        return env_gpu
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=index,memory.used,memory.total",
             "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10,
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            log.warning(f"nvidia-smi failed (rc={result.returncode}), falling back to GPU 0")
            return "0"
        best_idx, best_used, best_free = "0", float("inf"), 0
        for line in result.stdout.strip().split("\n"):
            parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(",")]
            if len(parts) < 3:
                continue
            idx, used, total = parts[0], int(parts[1]), int(parts[2])
            free = total - used
            if used < best_used:
                best_idx, best_used, best_free = idx, used, free
        if best_free < MIN_FREE_MB:
            log.warning(f"Best GPU {best_idx} has only {best_free}MB free (need {MIN_FREE_MB}MB), using it anyway")
        log.info(f"Selected GPU {best_idx} (used={best_used}MB, free={best_free}MB)")
        return best_idx
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning(f"GPU detection failed ({e}), falling back to GPU 0")
        return "0"


def extract_exp_id(dirname):
    return os.path.basename(dirname)


def find_ready_checkpoints():
    ready = []
    for d in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(MODELS_DIR, "*"))):
        if not os.path.isdir(d):
            continue
        exp_id = extract_exp_id(d)
        final_dir = os.path.join(d, "final")
        if os.path.isdir(final_dir) and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(final_dir, "model.safetensors")):
            result_name = f"{exp_id}_eval.json"
            result_path = os.path.join(EVAL_DIR, result_name)
            if not os.path.exists(result_path):
                ready.append((exp_id, final_dir, result_path))
    return ready


def run_eval(exp_id, checkpoint_path, output_path):
    eval_gpu = get_least_loaded_gpu()
    cmd = [
        sys.executable, EVAL_SCRIPT,
        "--checkpoints", checkpoint_path,
        "--data_path", DATA_PATH,
        "--output_path", output_path,
    ]
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = eval_gpu
    log.info(f"Starting eval: {exp_id} on GPU {eval_gpu} -> {output_path}")
    log.info(f"  cmd: {' '.join(cmd)}")
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=1800)
        if proc.returncode == 0:
            log.info(f"Eval succeeded: {exp_id}")
            if proc.stdout:
                for line in proc.stdout.strip().split("\n")[-5:]:
                    log.info(f"  {line}")
            return True
        else:
            log.error(f"Eval failed (rc={proc.returncode}): {exp_id}")
            if proc.stderr:
                for line in proc.stderr.strip().split("\n")[-10:]:
                    log.error(f"  {line}")
            if "CUDA out of memory" in (proc.stderr or ""):
                log.info(f"GPU OOM, retrying on CPU: {exp_id}")
                env["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = ""
                proc2 = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=3600)
                if proc2.returncode == 0:
                    log.info(f"CPU eval succeeded: {exp_id}")
                    return True
                log.error(f"CPU eval also failed: {exp_id}")
            return False
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        log.error(f"Eval timed out: {exp_id}")
        return False
    except Exception as e:
        log.error(f"Eval exception: {exp_id}: {e}")
        return False


def main():
    os.makedirs(EVAL_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(LOG_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    log.info("=" * 60)
    log.info("Auto eval watcher started")
    log.info(f"  Models dir: {MODELS_DIR}")
    log.info(f"  Eval dir:   {EVAL_DIR}")
    log.info(f"  GPU select: dynamic (least loaded) | env EVAL_GPU overrides")
    log.info(f"  Min free:   {MIN_FREE_MB}MB")
    log.info(f"  Interval:   {SCAN_INTERVAL}s")
    log.info("=" * 60)

    evaluated = set()
    while True:
        try:
            ready = find_ready_checkpoints()
            if ready:
                log.info(f"Found {len(ready)} checkpoint(s) to eval")
            for exp_id, ckpt_path, result_path in ready:
                if exp_id in evaluated:
                    continue
                success = run_eval(exp_id, ckpt_path, result_path)
                if success:
                    evaluated.add(exp_id)
                else:
                    evaluated.add(exp_id)
                    log.warning(f"Skipping {exp_id} after failure (won't retry)")
        except Exception as e:
            log.error(f"Scan error: {e}")
        time.sleep(SCAN_INTERVAL)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
